name: fmp_symbol_search
description:
Finds ticker symbols by company name or partial symbol with Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): symbol, name, currency and exchange of each match.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/search-symbol as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): query (company name or symbol fragment, e.g. apple; FMP needs it although the schema does not mark it required).
For full lists use fmp_stock_list or fmp_etf_list; for renamed tickers fmp_symbol_changes.
Example: {"query": "apple"}

query.description: Company name or symbol fragment to search for
